source_title: International Students and Scholars Office: F-1 Off-Campus Employment
text: F-1 students working for a U.S. employer while physically in the United States need work authorization for off-campus employment. Depending on eligibility, authorization options include Curricular Practical Training (CPT) and Optional Practical Training (OPT). Check eligibility and authorization with the International Students and Scholars Office before starting work.

source_title: International Students and Scholars Office: F-1 Off-Campus Employment
text: Curricular Practical Training may be available after a year of full-time enrollment at a U.S. university in the academic year immediately before CPT. The training must occur before completing the minimum graduation requirements.
